  WHY: A push using an unresolved refspec such as `"$TARGET"` can target a different merged branch and proceed without verifying its actual source.

  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The documentation claims the merged-PR guard distinguishes adjacent from separated numeric redirection and prompts on unresolved push refspecs, but the guard hooks do not implement those behaviors.
  WHY: Operators and agents relying on these documented invariants may expect confirmation or inspection of the intended branch when the hooks instead fall back to the current branch.

  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_enforce_total_budget` runs before the reused-cache missing-file checks, so files deleted by current budget enforcement can be recorded as `cached_file_missing`.
  WHY: The next stage sees the skip reason and does not re-fetch a file that had been present in the cache; severity disagreement: deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro classified this as MAJOR, while openai_gpt-6-luna classified the combined evidence-reporting issue as NIT.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_evidence.py: line 1238 | severity=high | confidence=[5]

  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]

  WHY: The test passes despite the index rendering the contradictory “dropped: size limit” label.
